definitions.pairedSeeds: Seed depends only on repetition, never attribute/context.
definitions.fixture: 22 canonical players, 6 seconds by default; scanning fixtures hold decision cooldown to isolate physical movement; release context permits normal NPC choices.
definitions.static: Both actors <0.25m/s within2.5m, controlled ball relative speed<0.3m/s, no challenge/action/intent/phase change or target/ball displacement>0.35m, for>=1 continuous second. Diagnostic only.
definitions.structuralFailures: 0.5-second samples with any advanced central attacker >8m from nearest outfield defender; not attribution of a conceded chance.
definitions.fixedContact: Forced standing action at identical reachable geometry; aggression is excluded from resolver quality.
definitions.supportDistance: Cumulative actual movement of local attacking teammates, not a claimed response latency.
definitions.acceleration: Model has no separate acceleration or balance attribute. Pace/agility/strength sweeps affect derived physical acceleration; agility represents body recovery.
definitions.cards: Actual canonical issued card identities during the episode; pending cards remain pending.

sourceFingerprint.scope: Sorted non-test .ts files in src/core/matchSimulation; relative path + NUL + bytes + NUL

provenance.policy: Fresh complete paired rerun on immutable baseline or frozen final runtime. Source fingerprint added after run; future benchmark runs calculate and verify the fingerprint themselves.
provenance.lateFixture: 83-minute contexts correctly use second_half. Earlier first_half late-trailing rows were invalid and are superseded by this complete rerun.
